SELECT enqueteur_nom AS enqueteur,
       COUNT(*) AS fiches,
       ROUND(AVG(duree_sec) / 60.0, 1) AS duree_moyenne_min,
       ROUND(AVG(duree_sec)) AS duree_moyenne_sec
FROM reponses
WHERE statut <> 'rejected'
  AND duree_sec IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY enqueteur_nom
ORDER BY duree_moyenne_min DESC
